name: mode-bar
title: Mode bar
description: A bar that says you are in a special mode (test data, viewing as someone else, read-only or beta) and gives the one way out. It cannot be dismissed.
docs: kind is 'test', 'viewing-as', 'read-only' or 'beta': each has its own icon, its own word in a chip and its own weight (hatched, inverted, plain, a card), so the mode reads without colour. title adds whose account it is for viewing-as, description says what is different in plain words, and onExit adds the single Exit button, named 'Exit: Test mode' for a screen reader. There is no close button on purpose: a mode that can be hidden is how mistakes on real data happen. Without onExit there is no button at all, for a mode the person cannot leave. The bar is a labelled region, so screen reader users can jump to it. sticky pins it under the header; pass className='top-14' to sit under a 56px header. labels carries every word.
